10k.note: 10-K describes Tablo Hemodialysis System — an FDA-cleared (510(k)) commercial medical device for acute, chronic in-center, and home hemodialysis. No drug pipeline.

website.note: Page lists post-market clinical studies / registries (HOME Registry NCT04526301, real-world implementation studies, retrospective analyses) for the Tablo system. No P1/P2/P3 trials — these are device-evidence studies, not phased drug trials.

ctgov.note: All 6 sponsored studies are observational / device registries (no Phase 1-3).

commercial_product.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) cleared for use in acute care, chronic in-center dialysis clinics, and home hemodialysis. CE mark not applicable — US-only commercial focus.
commercial_product.indication: End-stage kidney disease (ESKD) and acute kidney injury (AKI) requiring hemodialysis.

current_evidence_studies.name: HOME Registry
current_evidence_studies.design: Prospective multi-center observational registry of home hemodialysis with Tablo

current_evidence_studies.name: Post-market real-world evidence
current_evidence_studies.design: Multiple retrospective and implementation studies (St. Francis clearance, Dialysis Symptom Index, PIKRT outcomes, rural Alaska/Iowa, Hawaii HHD program)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device company (hemodialysis hardware). Tablo Hemodialysis System is already FDA 510(k) cleared and commercially marketed. All sponsored clinical activity is post-market observational / registry / implementation studies, not P1/P2/P3 drug or pivotal IDE trials. No proprietary therapeutic pipeline.
